items.title_zh: SyNexus项目：GitHub上的非侵入式自适应脑机接口
items.title_en: SyNexus-Project: Non-invasive Adaptive BCI on GitHub
bullets_zh: GitHub仓库SyNexus，一种采集初级运动皮层信号的非侵入式自适应脑机接口。
在2026年创新医疗器械竞赛与展示会上展出。
记录面向神经病变和神经创伤应用的软硬件架构及实验流程。
bullets_en: GitHub repository for SyNexus, a non-invasive adaptive BCI acquiring primary motor cortex signals.
Presented at the Innovating Biomedical Devices Competition and Showcase 2026.
Documents hardware/software architecture and experimental pipeline for neuropathology and neurotrauma applications.
items.brief: GitHub上的非侵入式自适应BCI项目，展示运动皮层信号采集与医疗应用潜力。
items.brief_en: GitHub repo for a non-invasive adaptive BCI using motor-cortex signals, shown at a biomedical-device competition.
items.raw_excerpt: Presented at the Innovating Biomedical Devices Competition and Showcase 2026. A Non-invasive and Adaptive Brain-Computer Interface acquiring signals from the primary motor cortex to address neuropathologies and neurotrauma. Covers hardware/software architecture, the experimental pipeline, and future developments in componentry and connectivity.

items.title_zh: NIA项目：GitHub上的非侵入式脑机接口集成数字环境
items.title_en: NIA-Project: Integrated Digital Environment for Non-invasive BCIs on GitHub
bullets_zh: GitHub仓库NIA，面向自适应非侵入式脑机接口人机数字交互的集成数字环境。
该项目侧重脑机接口软件基础设施，而非单一头带或数据集。
它有助于构建实用的非侵入式脑机接口生态系统。
bullets_en: GitHub repository for NIA, an integrated digital environment for human-digital interaction in adaptive non-invasive BCIs.
The project focuses on BCI software infrastructure rather than a single headset or dataset.
It is relevant to building practical ecosystems for non-invasive brain-computer interfaces.
items.brief: GitHub上的非侵入式BCI数字交互环境项目，关注自适应人机接口生态。
items.brief_en: GitHub project for an integrated digital environment enabling human-digital interaction in adaptive non-invasive BCIs.
items.raw_excerpt: Realization of an Integrated Digital Environment for Human-Digital Interaction in Adaptive and Non-invasive Brain-Computer Interfaces

items.title_en: AxonOS Community Radar for Open BCI Field
bullets_zh: 社区项目维护一个自动更新的开放脑机接口领域活地图。
帮助用户发现非侵入式BCI生态中的工具、数据集和项目。
bullets_en: Community project maintaining a living, auto-updated map of the open brain-computer-interface field.
Helps users discover tools, datasets, and projects across non-invasive BCI ecosystems.
items.brief: 自动更新的开放脑机接口领域地图，便于追踪生态。
items.brief_en: Auto-updated map of the open brain-computer-interface field for tracking ecosystem resources.
items.raw_excerpt: AxonOS Radar — a living, auto-updated map of the open brain-computer-interface field. An AxonOS community project.

items.title_zh: BCI/EEG开放资源与新闻论文归档
items.title_en: Curated BCI/EEG Resources and News Archive
bullets_zh: 整理开放的BCI/EEG数据集、模型和处理方法。
归档相关新闻和论文，便于快速查阅。
bullets_en: Curates open BCI/EEG datasets, models, and processing methods.
Archives related news and papers for quick reference.
items.brief: 整理BCI/EEG数据集、模型、方法与新闻论文的仓库。
items.brief_en: Curated open datasets, models, methods, and archived news/papers for BCI/EEG.
items.raw_excerpt: Curated BCI/EEG open datasets, models, processing methods, and archived news/papers

bullets_zh: 利用SSVEP和EEG信号实时选择基本需求。
面向辅助沟通或控制应用场景。
bullets_en: Uses SSVEP and EEG signals to select basic needs in real time.
Targets assistive communication or control applications.
items.brief: 基于SSVEP的实时基本需求选择辅助BCI。
items.brief_en: Assistive SSVEP-based EEG BCI for real-time basic-need selection.
items.raw_excerpt: MindAid Assistive SSVEP BCI. Assistive SSVEP-based Brain-Computer Interface (BCI) for real-time selection of basic needs through EEG signals.

bullets_zh: 结合P300和SSVEP进行离线分类器训练。
提供浏览器校准，并通过LSL实时输出操作系统按键。
bullets_en: Combines P300 and SSVEP for offline classifier training.
Provides browser-based calibration and real-time OS keypress output via LSL.
items.brief: 离线训练、浏览器校准并实时输出按键的BCI拼写器。
items.brief_en: Offline-trained P300/SSVEP speller with browser calibration and LSL keypress output.
items.raw_excerpt: P300 + SSVEP brain-computer interface speller — offline classifier training, browser-based calibration, real-time OS keypress output via LSL.

items.title_zh: 用于智能家居控制的脑机接口
items.title_en: EEG BCI for Smart Home Control
bullets_zh: 使用CNN-BiLSTM从实时EEG中分类眨眼和注意状态。
通过模糊逻辑决策层驱动ESP32执行器，实现免手动控制。
bullets_en: Classifies blink and attention from real-time EEG with CNN-BiLSTM.
Uses a fuzzy-logic decision layer to drive ESP32 actuators for hands-free control.
items.brief: 实时EEG控制智能家居，结合CNN-BiLSTM与模糊逻辑。
items.brief_en: Real-time EEG smart-home control using CNN-BiLSTM and fuzzy logic.
items.raw_excerpt: Real-time EEG brain-computer interface for hands-free smart-home control — CNN-BiLSTM blink and attention classification with a fuzzy-logic decision layer, driving ESP32 actuators

bullets_zh: 在PyTorch中实现密集卷积Transformer。
面向脑机接口应用中的EEG信号解码。
bullets_en: Implements a dense convolutional transformer in PyTorch.
Targets EEG signal decoding for brain-computer interface applications.
items.brief: PyTorch实现密集卷积Transformer，用于EEG信号解码。
items.brief_en: PyTorch dense convolutional transformer for decoding EEG in BCI applications.
items.raw_excerpt: Decode EEG signals using this PyTorch implementation of a dense convolutional transformer for brain-computer interface applications.

bullets_zh: GitHub项目构建面向8–64通道硬件的ADS1299开源EEG/BCI生态。
包含MCU/FPGA参考包、PC/移动/Linux集成以及Python/MATLAB/R分析流程。
适用于非侵入式脑电采集、验证、教学和研究。
bullets_en: GitHub project builds an open ADS1299 EEG/BCI ecosystem for 8–64 channel hardware.
Includes MCU/FPGA reference packages, PC/mobile/Linux integration, and Python/MATLAB/R analysis workflows.
Useful for non-invasive EEG acquisition, validation, education, and research.
items.brief: 面向ADS1299的开源EEG/BCI硬件与软件生态，适合非侵入式脑电研究。
items.brief_en: Open ADS1299 EEG/BCI ecosystem for non-invasive brain-computer interface research and development.
items.raw_excerpt: Building the world’s largest and most comprehensive open ADS1299 EEG/BCI ecosystem — 8–64CH hardware, 200 MCU/SoC/DSP & FPGA target/reference packages, Verilog RTL, PC/mobile/Linux integration, Python/MATLAB/R EEG analysis, BCI workflows, validation, education and research.

bullets_zh: GitHub文档介绍Nimbus SDK与API，支持Julia和Python。
覆盖概率推断、BCI工作流、预处理、批量/流式推理及集成。
可作为非侵入式脑机接口数据处理与部署的软件工具包。
bullets_en: GitHub documentation for Nimbus SDKs and APIs in Julia and Python.
Covers probabilistic inference, BCI workflows, preprocessing, batch/streaming inference, and integrations.
Relevant as a software toolkit for non-invasive BCI data processing and deployment.
items.brief: Nimbus BCI的Julia/Python SDK文档，覆盖推理、预处理与流式工作流。
items.brief_en: Documentation for Nimbus BCI SDKs in Julia and Python, covering inference, preprocessing, and streaming workflows.
items.raw_excerpt: Documentation for Nimbus SDKs and APIs across Julia and Python, covering probabilistic inference, BCI workflows, preprocessing, batch and streaming inference, and integrations.

items.title_zh: 基于BrainLink Pro的Unity脑机交互游戏应用
items.title_en: Unity Mobile App for BrainLink Pro BCI Interaction in Games
bullets_zh: GitHub项目提供兼容非侵入式BrainLink Pro头显的Unity移动应用。
它展示在视频游戏中通过BCI进行交互，可作为消费级EEG集成示例。
bullets_en: A GitHub project provides a Unity mobile application compatible with the non-invasive BrainLink Pro headset.
It demonstrates BCI-based interaction inside video games, useful as a consumer EEG integration example.
items.brief: 展示用BrainLink Pro在Unity游戏中实现非侵入式BCI交互。
items.brief_en: Shows a Unity mobile app using BrainLink Pro for non-invasive BCI interaction in games.
items.raw_excerpt: Aplicación móvil desarrollada en Unity compatible con BrainLink Pro para la interacción mediante Interfaces Cerebro-Computadora (BCI) en videojuegos.

items.title_zh: 对AI驱动脑机接口的攻击触及神经要害
items.title_en: Hitting a NERVE with attacks on AI-powered brain-computer interfaces
bullets_zh: 一篇2026年9月的HN文章讨论对AI驱动脑机接口的攻击。
其意义在于对抗性操纵基于机器学习的BCI解码器可能影响安全性和可靠性。
bullets_en: A September 2026 HN note discusses attacks on AI-powered brain-computer interfaces.
It matters because adversarial manipulation of ML-based BCI decoders could affect safety and reliability.
items.brief: 讨论AI脑机接口安全攻击，提醒解码器易受对抗扰动影响。
items.brief_en: Discusses security attacks on AI-powered BCIs and why adversarial risks matter for neural decoders.
